motion.evidence: 74 IntersectionObservers / 74 targets (threshold ~0-0.01, rootMargin 500-1000px pre-arm); 18 scroll + 23 mousemove listeners; 2095 rAF calls per scroll pass; 6 canvas, 2 marquees, 78 draggable, 17 disclosure. 0 @keyframes / 0 CSS-animation rules / 0 libraries detected (stylesheets CORS-blocked → engine is JS-driven rAF, not declarative CSS). 0 prefers-reduced-motion rules → reduced motion NOT respected. Recurring brand gradient appears as DISTINCT per-section STATIC color fields (hero ribbon s00, card swatches s05, full-bleed top band s06, navy aurora s07) — NOT one ribbon repositioned by scroll; scroll_effects contain zero background/gradient/scroll-progress entries, so gradient motion is unproven. Scroll_effects from frame-diffing: 7 transform/parallax (billing-plan-graphic layers + 3 Order-Summary cards), scale 1→0 (connection-ring), $999 figure opacity 1→0 + scale 1→0.4; 2 from==to entries dropped as noise. Static token values normalized from a noisy profile; motion fields evidence-backed (frames + probes), durations/easings are the captured craftParams set.

notes: Normalized from a noisy raw profile (1867 of ~2200 nodes were 16px body; sub-pixel sizes like 14.5px/15.5px/22.4px rounded to the nearest step). Single family Söhne (sohne-var); only weights 300+400 observed — no bold, confirmed by screenshot where headline weight reads light/regular. Accent unified to one violet #533afd (raw rgb(83,58,253)); a few native links use legacy #0000ee. Neutrals deliberately blue-slate, not gray (ink #061b31, slate #50617a/#64748d). Type scale reduced from 14 raw font-sizes to a 7-step ramp matching what the screenshots show (body 16, labels 14, section head ~26-32, hero ~48-56). Radii collapsed to 4/6px (the 1px entries are hairline borders, not corner radius). Shadows kept only the two real floating-element shadows; most cards are flat. Spacing mapped to a 4/8px base; the section-defining jumps are 32→64→96px. Brand orange appears only inside gradients, not as a UI color.
